title_sq: Tek Parku Olimpik, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Orientim Dhe Planimetri Perfekte !!
description_sq: Tek Parku Olimpik, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Orientim Dhe Planimetri Perfekte !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e shtate te objektit United Towers Of Tirana ndertimi te ri aktualisht ne faze karabinaje. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 82.9 m2. Organizohet ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti. Orientimi i apartamentit jug-perendim si dhe pamja e lire i mundesojne diell dhe ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte nga me te kerkuarat per nje jetese sa me komode si per banim dhe per investim per shkak te kerkeses se larte per qira.
title_en: At the Olympic Park, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect orientation and layout!!
description_en: At the Olympic Park, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect orientation and layout!! The apartment is located on the seventh floor of the United Towers Of Tirana building, a new building currently in the construction phase. The apartment has a total area of ​​82.9 m2. It is organized in the living room together with the cooking corner, a bedroom with access to the balcony and a toilet. The south-west orientation of the apartment as well as the free view allow sun and natural lighting throughout the day. The area in which it is located is one of the most sought after for a comfortable lifestyle, both for residence and investment, due to the high demand for rent.
